end.summary:
- Predicted that balls, bottles, and drums with curved surfaces roll; this was shown with a new situation (glass).
- Practised predicting that flat-faced boxes slide; easy questions were answered right, but a why or new situation is still to check.
- Practised that the same object can roll one way and stand or stack another way; this is still building.
- Practised stacking with flat tops and bottoms; the box-stacking idea is still to check, and the round-part mix-up remained at the last check.
end.parentNote: Anika practised sorting objects that roll, slide, or stack. They used curved sides to explain why a ball, bottle, drum, and lying glass roll, and used a flat bottom to explain why a box slides. They also described making a box tower, but mixed up the idea that a round part means an object cannot stack; this was not corrected by the last check. At home, try placing a bottle upright and on its side, then ask which way it can roll and which way it can stand.
